business_summary: Yantai Yatong Precision Mechanical Corporation engages in the research and development, production, sale, and service of auto parts and mining auxiliary transportation equipment in China and internationally. The company provides automotive stamping parts, die-casting parts, rolling parts, and module components for robot welding systems; engine compartment, door sill plate, side inner panel, and floor assemblies; and transmission housings, body die-casting structural parts, and non-metallic protective plates. The company is also involved in manufacturing processes of stamping, rolling, die-casting, welding, painting, riveting, and assembly of sedans. In addition, it provides top cover assemblies, front wall assemblies, rear wall assemblies, components, side panel assemblies, floor assemblies, aluminum and magnesium alloy die-cast structural parts assemblies, die-cast transmission casing, metal exterior parts assemblies, etc., as well as engages in manufacturing processes, such as stamping, rolling, die-casting, welding, painting, riveting, and assembly for heavy and light truck production. Further, it offers transportation services for underground production, including hardening of underground roads and roadway walls, transportation and spraying of reinforced concrete, handling of hydraulic supports, transportation of other large underground equipment and personnel; and trackless rubber wheeled vehicles and rental services for support vehicles for large coal mines, including equipment, material and personnel transportation services, operation and maintenance, accessory supply, and technical services. Additionally, the company offers electric pumps and tanks, proof diesel engine concrete pump, explosion-proof diesel scrapers, explosion-proof diesel engine concrete pump, explosion-proof diesel engine wet concrete spray, support, and shovel trucks. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Yantai, China.
business_summary_ko: Yantai Yatong Precision Mechanical Corporation은 중국 및 국제적으로 자동차 부품 및 광산 보조 운송 장비의 연구 개발, 생산, 판매 및 서비스에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 로봇 용접 시스템용 자동차 스탬핑 부품, 다이캐스팅 부품, 롤링 부품 및 모듈 부품을 제공합니다. 엔진룸, 도어 실 플레이트, 측면 내부 패널 및 바닥 어셈블리; 변속기 하우징, 차체 다이캐스팅 구조 부품, 비금속 보호판 등이 있습니다. 이 회사는 또한 스탬핑, 롤링, 다이캐스팅, 용접, 페인팅, 리벳팅 및 세단 조립 등의 제조 공정에도 참여하고 있습니다. 또한 상단 커버 어셈블리, 전면 벽 어셈블리, 후면 벽 어셈블리, 부품, 측면 패널 어셈블리, 바닥 어셈블리, 알루미늄 및 마그네슘 합금 다이캐스트 구조 부품 어셈블리, 다이캐스트 변속기 케이싱, 금속 외부 부품 어셈블리 등을 제공할 뿐만 아니라 대형 및 경트럭 생산을 위한 스탬핑, 롤링, 다이캐스팅, 용접, 페인팅, 리벳팅 및 어셈블리와 같은 제조 공정에도 참여합니다. 또한, 경화를 포함하여 지하 생산을 위한 운송 서비스를 제공합니다.
